chunks: Every time a sign comes to them they say: "We shall never believe till what God's apostles had been given comes to us." God knows best where to direct His messages. A degradation will befall the sinners and chastisement from God for deceiving.
ai.seo_question: Why did the disbelievers refuse to believe even when signs came to them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the stubbornness of the disbelievers who demanded specific, tangible miracles like those of previous prophets, ignoring the sufficiency of the Prophet Muhammad's intellectual and spiritual signs. It underscores the divine wisdom in choosing the location and nature of revelation, warning that their scheming will result in divine humiliation and severe punishment.
